;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Syrian Civil War]], [[Kurdish–Turkish conflict (2015–present)]], [[Northern Syria Buffer Zone]]
**Turkish President [[Recep Tayyip Erdoğan]] threatens to [[Invasion|invade]] [[Syrian Democratic Forces|SDF]]-held areas in Northern [[Syria]] "today or tomorrow", after dubbing joint US-Turkish patrols per the [[Northern Syria Buffer Zone|buffer zone agreement]] a "[[fairy tale]]". [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-syria-security-turkey-usa-idUSKCN1WK053 (Reuters)] [https://www.dailysabah.com/war-on-terror/2019/10/05/turkey-ready-for-operation-east-of-euphrates-in-syria-erdogan-says (''Daily Sabah'')]
*[[Paris police headquarters stabbing]]
**[[Counter-terror]] investigators confirm the man who killed four people at [[Paris]] [[law enforcement in France|police]] headquarters two days ago was a [[religious conversion#Islam|convert]] who adhered to [[Islamic extremism|Islamist extremism]] and had contact with Salafists. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-49945640 (BBC News)]
;Disasters and accidents
*[[2019 Totnes bus crash]]
**A major incident has been declared in [[Devon]], [[England]], after a double-decker bus overturned near the town of [[Totnes]] while operating a busy passenger service between the [[Torbay|English Riviera]] coast and the city of [[Plymouth]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-devon-49944705 (BBC News)]
**More than fifty people, including the bus driver, have been injured; eight people have serious injuries. Local hospitals have been overwhelmed with patients attending from the bus crash and forced to close to non-emergency care. [https://www.itv.com/news/westcountry/2019-10-05/up-to-eight-people-seriously-injured-after-double-decker-overturns-in-devon-road (ITV)]
*[[Ukraine–European Union relations]]
**The [[European Aviation Safety Agency]] revokes its authorisation of [[Ukraine Air Alliance]], effectively banning the airline from all airspace in the [[European Union]]. The move results from yesterday's crash of an [[Antonov An-12]] owned by the airline, after it ran out of fuel near [[Lviv]], [[Ukraine]]. [http://avherald.com/h?article=4cd99477&opt=0 (The Aviation Herald)]
;International relations
*[[Russia–Venezuela relations]]
**Russian Deputy Prime Minister [[Yury Borisov|Yuri Borisov]] visits ally Venezuela, reiterating Russia's support of [[2019 Venezuelan presidential crisis|disputed president]] [[Nicolás Maduro]] and announcing new trade deals with the economically crippled country. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-russia-venezuela/russian-deputy-prime-minister-in-venezuela-to-support-maduro-idUSKCN1WK0CF (Reuters)]

;Law and crime
*In [[Lower Manhattan]], [[New York City]], four [[homelessness in the United States|homeless]] men are beaten to death and a fifth severely injured while sleeping. A 24-year-old man, also believed homeless, is in custody. [https://edition.cnn.com/2019/10/05/us/new-york-homeless-men-killed/index.html (CNN)]
*After acquitting five Muslim men of murder, [[Thailand|Thai]] judge [[Kanakorn Pianchana]] gives a speech complaining of corrupt pressure upon the judiciary, including in this case, to convict without sufficient evidence. He then shoots himself in the chest in court in [[Yala Province|Yala]], but survives. Criticism from judges of the Thai legal system is rare, but rights groups claim Muslims often face trumped-up charges in the region, which is Muslim-majority and suffers from insurgency. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-49945636 (BBC News)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2019 Emirati parliamentary election]]
**A pool of citizens of the [[United Arab Emirates]] heads to the polls in the country's fourth parliamentary election. [https://gulfnews.com/uae/government/emiratis-head-to-the-polls-in-fnc-elections-1.66903098 (''Gulf News'')]

;Sports
*[[2019 World Artistic Gymnastics Championships]]
**In the [[Floor (gymnastics)|floor exercise]], [[Simone Biles]] lands a triple-twisting double backflip in a tucked position. The new skill will be named "Biles 2", the third element named after her, and will have an [[Code of Points (artistic gymnastics)#The FIG Code of Points|FIG difficulty value]] of J. [https://www.yahoo.com/lifestyle/simone-biles-starts-off-worlds-185211838.html (PopSugar via Yahoo!)]
